card.name: Praise and compliment words
card.fires_on: Words of praise or admiration, such as praise, compliment, congratulate, admire, in general web text. It also fires weakly on 'to' after verbs of speaking.

modes.label: Praise verbs
modes.description: Verbs or nouns for praising, complimenting or congratulating someone.
modes.example: Finally, always<< praise>> your children for what they learn.

modes.label: Partway through praise words
modes.description: The middle of a praise word split into pieces, like Compl-iment or P-raise.
modes.example: Compl<<iment>> slip from Association for the Supply of Pure

modes.label: Speech 'to' or approval
modes.description: The word 'to' after talk or remark, or an approving adjective like nice.

card.writes: It seems to push toward words that continue praise or remark words, such as 'swell', 'sing' and 'remark'.
